## Core Technical Capabilities
- **Generative AI & LLMs:** RAG architectures, prompt compression, semantic caching, function calling, fine-tuning, multi-agent workflows, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone).
- **Voice AI & Real-time Agents:** WebRTC audio streaming, LiveKit, low-latency STT/TTS pipelines, conversational barge-in, 3D interactive avatars.
- **Real-Time Data Platforms:** Apache Kafka, Redpanda, Apache Flink stateful processing, Apache Iceberg lakehouses, Trino distributed SQL, Nessie catalog, Change Data Capture (CDC).
- **Full Stack Development:** Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js, Angular, React, Vue, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
